summary: Iteration 2 (multi-user invite system): 17/17 backend pytest tests PASS. All key features verified: register with action=create returns token + creates league with unique 6-digit code (admin membership), register with action=join + invite_code=123456 joins demo league, duplicate team_name in same league returns 409, POST /api/leagues/create (auth) works, POST /api/leagues/join works, GET /api/leagues/{id}/members returns team_names+roles, GET /api/leagues/{id}/my-membership works, dashboard exposes my_team_name='Milano Warriors', standings expose team_name field, /api/players returns exactly 213 players (Osimhen absent; Nico Paz, Lautaro Martinez, Rasmus Højlund, Scott McTominay present). Frontend: Sign-in with demo creds -> Dashboard shows 'Milano Warriors' as team title + 'Codice invito 123456' strip; Lega tab shows big 123456 code, ADMIN badge on demo user, working Copia button ('Copiato!' feedback), Membri list with team_names for all seeded managers. Sign-up screen toggles correctly between 'Crea lega' (league_name field) and 'Unisciti con codice' (invite code field). Registering new user with action=join code=123456 successfully creates account, joins demo league, and lands on dashboard showing the new user's own team_name and the demo league code 123456.

ui_bugs.issue: Section header shows 'Membri N/8' hardcoded to /8. If more than 8 members join (as happened during automated join tests), counter reads e.g. '10/8'. Consider making the cap dynamic or based on league.max_members.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Persists from iteration 1; likely from a react-native-web dependency. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Make member counter dynamic in league.tsx instead of '/8'.
(Optional) Silence or migrate the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~950 lines with all handlers + seed in one file. Consider splitting: routes/auth.py, routes/leagues.py, routes/players.py, routes/auction.py, seed.py.

join_league_with_code case-insensitive team_name check uses $regex with user-supplied input WITHOUT escaping regex metacharacters — e.g. team_name='.*' could match anything. Recommend anchoring with re.escape(team_name) or use $eq with $regex '^' + escaped + '$'.

register with action='join' or 'create' still creates the user first; if league join then fails (e.g. duplicate team_name -> 409), the user account is persisted but has no league. Consider either transactional rollback or checking league validity before user insert.

auction/bid does not validate membership across leagues rigorously (already noted in iteration 1) — a member of league A cannot bid in league B due to membership check, but there is no test asserting 403.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly for API base URL.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login flow, dashboard my_team_name, invite strip, league tab code+ADMIN+Copia+members list, sign-up mode toggle, sign-up join creating account and joining demo league — all verified)

seed_data_creation: Test users are ephemeral (email prefix 'test_' + uuid; UI test used 'uitest_<epoch>@fanta.it'). They persist in DB but do not interfere with demo flows. Demo league now has extra memberships from tests (see UI bug about counter).

rca_of_issue: N/A — all target features working. Only a low-priority hardcoded '/8' counter and one minor security note (unescaped regex in join_league_with_code duplicate-team check) surfaced during code review.
